purpose: Repeat the already-frozen PRIVATE302 full SWE-chat browser-overlap measurement without a stored Hugging Face access token, using Hugging Face's documented user-scoped CI/CD OIDC exchange for read-only gated-repository access.

authentication.method: Hugging Face user-scoped CI/CD OIDC access
authentication.secret_value_semantics: Hugging Face username configured as the user-scoped OIDC resource. It is stored as a GitHub secret only to prevent the username from appearing in public Actions logs; it is not an access credential and must not be output or retained.
authentication.hub_side_precondition: The same Hugging Face user must already have accepted access to SALT-NLP/SWE-chat in the browser and must configure Authentication > CI/CD Access for GitHub Actions with repository ovladon/seenrelay and workflow swechat-full-browser-overlap-oidc.yml.

allowed_results.ACCESS_BLOCKED_NO_HF_OIDC_RESOURCE: GitHub Actions secret HF_OIDC_RESOURCE is absent or empty; no OIDC exchange and no dataset access.
allowed_results.ACCESS_BLOCKED_OIDC_EXCHANGE_REJECTED: GitHub OIDC token was requested but Hugging Face rejected the exchange; no dataset measurement is admissible.
allowed_results.ACCESS_BLOCKED_GATED_DATASET_NOT_ACCESSI: OIDC exchange succeeded but pinned gated dataset download was denied; no measurement is admissible.
allowed_results.MEASURED: OIDC exchange and authorized pinned dataset access succeeded, and the unchanged PRIVATE302 measurement completed and passed the aggregate validator.
